sentences.text: Adele Laurie Blue Adkins -LRB- -LSB- əˈdɛl -RSB- born 5 May 1988 -RRB- is an English singer-songwriter .

After graduating from the BRIT School for Performing Arts and Technology in 2006 , Adele was given a recording contract by XL Recordings after a friend posted her demo on Myspace the same year .	BRIT School	BRIT School	XL	XL Recordings	XL Recordings	XL Recordings	Myspace	Myspace
In 2007 , she received the Brit Awards `` Critics ' Choice '' award and won the BBC Sound of 2008 poll .	Brit Awards	2012 Brit Awards	BBC	BBC	Sound of 2008	Sound of 2008
Her debut album , 19 , was released in 2008 to commercial and critical success .	19	19 (Adele album)
It is certified seven times platinum in the UK , and three times platinum in the US .	platinum	Music recording sales certification#Certification thresholds
The album contains her first song , `` Hometown Glory '' , written when she was 16 , which is based on her home suburb of West Norwood in London .	Hometown Glory	Hometown Glory
An appearance she made on Saturday Night Live in late 2008 boosted her career in the US .	Saturday Night Live	Saturday Night Live

At the 51st Grammy Awards in 2009 , Adele received the awards for Best New Artist and Best Female Pop Vocal Performance .	51st Grammy Awards	51st Annual Grammy Awards	Best New Artist	Grammy Award for Best New Artist	Best Female Pop Vocal Performance	Grammy Award for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance	Grammy Awards	54th Annual Grammy Awards
She released her second studio album , 21 , in early 2011 .	21	21 (Adele album)

The album was critically well received and surpassed the success of her debut , earning the singer numerous awards in 2012 , among them a record-tying six Grammy Awards , including Album of the Year ; two Brit Awards , including British Album of the Year , and three American Music Awards .	Brit Awards	2012 Brit Awards	numerous awards	List of awards and nominations received by Adele	record-tying	Grammy Award records#Most Grammys won by a female artist in one night	Grammy Awards	54th Annual Grammy Awards	Album of the Year	Grammy Award for Album of the Year	British Album of the Year	2012 Brit Awards#Nominees and winners	American Music Awards	American Music Awards of 2011

The album has been certified 16 times platinum in the UK , and is the fourth best-selling album in the UK of all time .	platinum	Music recording sales certification#Certification thresholds	fourth best-selling album in the UK	List of best-selling albums in the United Kingdom
In the US , it has held the top position longer than any album since 1985 , and is certified diamond .	certified diamond	RIAA certification#RIAA Diamond certifications
The album has sold over 31 million copies worldwide .
The success of 21 earned Adele numerous mentions in the Guinness Book of World Records .	21	21 (Adele album)	Guinness Book of World Records	Guinness World Records

She is the first woman in the history of the Billboard Hot 100 to have three simultaneous top 10 singles as a lead artist , and the first female artist to simultaneously have two albums in the top five of the Billboard 200 and two singles in the top five of the Billboard Hot 100 .	Billboard	Billboard (magazine)
21 is the longest-running number one album by a female solo artist in the history of the UK and US Album Charts .	21	21 (Adele album)
In 2012 , Adele released `` Skyfall '' , which she co-wrote and recorded for the James Bond film of the same name .	Skyfall	Skyfall (song)	James Bond film of the same name	Skyfall

The song won an Academy Award , a Grammy Award , and a Golden Globe Award for Best Original Song , as well as the Brit Award for British Single of the Year .	Academy Award	Academy Award for Best Original Song	Grammy Award	Grammy Award for Best Song Written for Visual Media	Golden Globe Award for Best Original Song	Golden Globe Award for Best Original Song	Brit Award	Brit Awards
After taking a three-year break , Adele released her third studio album , 25 , in 2015 .	25	25 (Adele album)
It became the year 's best-selling album and broke first week sales records in the UK and US .	broke first week sales records	List of fastest-selling albums
